staff_gauge.reading_method: interval-specific linear pixel interpolation at the waterline
staff_gauge.annotation_rule: two independent readings; their mean is used when the difference is at most 0.5 cm; a third annotator independently re-reads every frame exceeding 0.5 cm

synchronization.clock: camera and LiDAR timestamps use the same network-disciplined host-computer clock
synchronization.matching: nearest 60-fps video frame to each retained LiDAR timestamp

spatial_relation: the staff gauge lies on the wall belt inside the LiDAR observation region of interest
bound_interpretation: protocol-derived operational estimate, not a traceable calibration certificate
